shots.action: Night, open sea. Close on a girl at the edge of a floating piece of aircraft skin: both arms over it, eyes wide, mouth open, breathing hard. A wave slaps the panel and white water jumps; her hands slide and grip again
shots.camera: Close, just above the panel, easing in

shots.action: Her hands on the torn metal edge: they slide back towards the water, then clamp down again. Her face behind them, eyes wide
shots.camera: Very close on the hands, low

shots.action: From high up: one small figure at a piece of wreckage, debris scattered round it, black water in every direction. She turns her head, looking
shots.camera: High and wide, rising

shots.action: Along the wreckage: torn metal, ribs, a row of window holes. She hangs on at the far end, looking back along it, eyes wide
shots.camera: Low, tracking along the panel

shots.action: She turns her head: behind her a crow in a long coat flaps down onto a floating floor panel, eyes wide, sheds a feather and crouches
shots.camera: Over the wreckage, past her head

shots.action: Rook crouched on his panel, arms folding, hat brim low, eyes half shut; the girl at the wreckage behind him, still looking round
shots.camera: Three-quarter, low on the water

shots.action: Straight down: she is a small shape at the edge of the panel, head tipped back, turning one way and the other, mouth open
shots.camera: Top down, slowly descending and turning

shots.action: Close: she lifts her chin and calls out, turning her head left, then right, eyes wide, brows up
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter, easing in

shots.action: Over her head into the dark: dim shapes of debris and no one. On his panel Rook cups a wing to the side of his head and turns it, listening
shots.camera: Behind her, looking out, drifting in

shots.action: Close on Rook: he lowers the wing, looks across at her, brows sad, and his hat brim comes down. He says nothing
shots.camera: Close, eye level

shots.action: Low on the water: a black swell rises behind the wreckage and lifts it and her with it; white water breaks over the edge; her eyes are shut tight
shots.camera: Very low, rolling with the swell

shots.action: She heaves herself up on straight arms, eyes shut with the effort; the panel tips towards her and she slides back into the water with a splash. Rook half rises on his panel, eyes wide
shots.camera: Low, three-quarter from the end of the wreckage

shots.action: Her cheek goes down on her arm, eyes heavy. Rook has crossed to the wreckage: he crouches at its edge and lays a wing on it beside her hands, brows sad, silent
shots.camera: Across the panel, level with her face, easing in

shots.action: Very close: her eyes close, open, close; her head sinks and jerks back up
shots.camera: Very close, eye level

shots.action: Wide and low: the sky behind them goes from black to orange and the sun comes up out of the sea. Two small shapes at the wreckage
shots.camera: Low and wide, drifting in

shots.action: Grey morning, a bigger sea. She is still there, arms over the edge, head up, looking round with tired eyes. Rook turns his head with hers
shots.camera: Three-quarter from the end of the panel

shots.action: From behind her: across the wreckage, on the horizon, a white boat. Rook jumps to his feet and points at it with his whole wing; his hat hops. Her head comes up
shots.camera: Behind her, looking out over the panel

shots.action: The boat comes on, bow rising and falling, foam at the stem. Two crewmen at the rail lean out and point down at her, shouting
shots.camera: Low on the water, looking up at the bow

shots.action: From the deck, over the crew's shoulders: one of them swings back and throws an orange life ring; it sails out on its line towards the girl at the wreckage below
shots.camera: High on the deck, looking down at her

shots.action: Water level: the ring slaps down short of the wreckage and the next swell carries it off sideways. Her arm comes out over the panel towards it
shots.camera: Very low on the water, rolling

shots.action: Close: her arm at full stretch across the panel, fingers open, eyes wide; the ring slides away. Beside her Rook stretches a wing after it too, beak open
shots.camera: Close, across the panel

shots.action: From the water: one sailor goes over the rail and drops feet first into the swell in a burst of white water. The others lean out after him
shots.camera: Low on the water, looking up at the rail

shots.action: From above: he swims round the end of the wreckage, gets an arm round her, and her hands let go of the panel. Rook leans down over the edge, brows soft
shots.camera: High three-quarter, easing in

shots.action: At the boat's side: the sailor in the water pushes her up; two crewmen hang over the rail and take her arms
shots.camera: Low on the water, tilting up the hull

shots.action: On deck: she sits on a locker wrapped in bed covers; a crewman crouches and holds out a cup and she takes it. Another stands by. Rook sits on the rail, brows soft
shots.camera: Chest height on the deck, easing in

shots.action: Close on her face above the covers: she drinks from the cup, lowers it, and her eyes open
shots.camera: Close, eye level

shots.action: Seen from the sea: she sits at the rail in her covers and looks back over the water, brows sad. Rook sits on the rail beside her and looks the same way
shots.camera: From outside the boat, level with the rail

shots.action: A card, drawn like a child's picture of what she believes: an airliner in a night sky, and one small figure dropping away from it towards the sea
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: The same drawing goes on: the airliner comes down onto a runway with its lights on, and stops. WHAT SHE BELIEVED
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: The breath before: a quiet hospital room, evening in the window, the curtain moving. She sits up in the bed and turns her head to the door
shots.camera: Wide from the foot of the bed, easing in

shots.action: A woman in a white coat sits by the bed, leans in and lays a hand on the girl's hand, speaking, brows sad. The girl looks at her, and her eyes go wide
shots.camera: Medium, from the foot of the bed, easing in

shots.action: Close on her: her eyes go from wide to shut and her head goes down. At the window behind her Rook takes his hat off and holds it at his side, brows sad
shots.camera: Close, eye level, easing in

shots.action: Grey morning from high up: the piece of wreckage alone on a wide, empty sea, small debris round it. No one
shots.camera: Very high and wide, rising

shots.action: Low on the grey water: a seat cushion and a small case ride the swell past the camera; spray, and nothing else
shots.camera: Very low on the water, drifting and rolling

shots.action: The chair by the bed, empty now, evening light across its seat; the edge of her bed beside it, the curtain moving
shots.camera: Across the bed to the chair, drifting

shots.action: Rook at the window, hat off and held at his side, head bowed, brows sad, the evening behind him. He lifts his head a little to speak
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter

shots.action: Dusk on the sea. Rook on his floating panel, hat in his hand at his side; he puts it back on and pulls the brim down
shots.camera: Three-quarter, low on the water, pushing in

shots.action: Rook's case board, a sheet of riveted aircraft skin: a photograph of the girl at the wreckage on the night sea, 153 ON BOARD, 1 SURVIVOR. No stamp
shots.camera: Flat insert

shots.action: Back to the first picture: the girl at the edge of the wreckage in the dark, played back to its first frame
shots.camera: The opening framing
